intro.text: A large sea enclosed by land, bordering Hallandren and holding an unknown number of islands. The city of T'Telir is built right up against its shore.

description.text: The sea gives the kingdoms around it many routes for trade.

Many nations line its shores. Hallandren, the strongest, holds the western shore, around a third of the whole coast, and some islands; its capital, T'Telir, sits in a bay and trades with Tedradel, across the water to the east, and many coastal cities, growing hugely rich as the biggest market for the precious Tears of Edgli. The Chedesh, a fallen seafaring people said to have first found the Hallandren valley, once lived on the eastern shore.
Hallandren's Stormrunners sail it through the spring storms, and the sea is a large part of why Hallandren is such an economic power.
Its waters teem with mussels, fish and tentacled creatures, and spring brings dangerous storms.
